dataset: GTZAN features_3_sec.csv, averaged to one row per track
cluster_evaluation_space: 57 standardized mean track features, not 2D plots

cluster_metrics.method: Diagonal GMM on standardized track features

metric_notes.silhouette: Higher is better; measures separation without using genre labels.
metric_notes.davies_bouldin: Lower is better; measures within-cluster spread relative to separation.
metric_notes.adjusted_rand_index: Higher is better; compares cluster assignments with genre labels.
metric_notes.normalized_mutual_information: Higher is better; compares cluster assignments with genre labels.
